title: Do Larger Audiences Generate Greater Revenues Under Pay What You Want? Evidence from a Live Streaming Platform
eligible_reason: Not a DiD design. Main results (Tables 7-11) are panel IV regressions (xtivreg, fe) of tips on the displayed audience size NumDisp (continuous), instrumented by the number of synthetic (bot) viewers NumSync, at the broadcast-minute level with broadcast FE and a linear minute trend t plus AvgTenure. No binary staggered treatment.
design_notes: code.do replicates Tables 7-11 'using a sub-sample': xtivreg TipTotal/TipRate (NumDisp [NumDisp_sq] = NumSync [NumSync_sq]) t AvgTenure if group>1 & minute>10, fe vce(cluster aid); xtreg NumReal L.NumReal NumSync ... fe (lagged outcome). Tables 8-11 add gender subsamples and moderator interactions (PreTotalTips, RecTend, FaceTime, HandTime, Emotion). The DiD full-text flag likely comes from discussion of the field experiment or literature, not from any coded DiD specification.
n_eligible_specs_note: No DiD specification in the package code.

specs.notes: Excluded: IV with continuous regressor; not a DiD.
